% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages, with a lastpage hint of 3 for a
% PDF of 4 pages: every page, and a range to the last page. test/run.mjs
% also builds this page without shell escape, as with --contain, where the
% number of pages is not read and the hint gives it, so the last page is 3.
% With shell escape, the number read overrides the hint, as pdflatex does,
% and the last page is 4. The run nohint has no hint: without shell
% escape it shows page 1 alone, and pdfpages' warning in the TeX log names
% the hint. The run closed has no hint either: a closed range needs no
% number of pages, so it shows every page of the range, with no LaTeX
% error. The run space merges four.pdf with spaced.pdf, a PDF of 2 pages
% found through \graphicspath in a folder whose name has a space, so
% extractbb reads four.pdf's number of pages and not spaced.pdf's:
% spaced.pdf gets the lastpage hint of 2, never four.pdf's 4. Each run
% starts with a paragraph "Run name."
% test/run.mjs builds it again with \PdfpagesMissing defined, for a run
% that includes a PDF that does not exist: pdfpages' error, and no picture.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\graphicspath{{test-pdfpages/my dir/}}
\begin{document}
Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-,lastpage=3]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run last.
\includepdf[pages={2-last},lastpage=3]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run nohint.
\includepdf[pages=-]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run closed.
\includepdf[pages={1-4}]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run space.
\includepdfmerge[lastpage=2]{test-pdfpages/four,-,spaced,-}

\ifdefined\PdfpagesMissing
Run missing.
\includepdf[pages={1-5},lastpage=5]{test-pdfpages/missing}

\fi
Run end.
\end{document}
